newsitem.title: DENMARK: CSFB DOWNGRADES NOVO NORDISK TO HOLD.
newsitem.headline: CSFB DOWNGRADES NOVO NORDISK TO HOLD.

text.p: Credit Suisse First Boston said on Thursday that it was switching its recommendation on Danish pharmaceutical group Novo Nordisk to hold, from buy and reducing its 1998 earnings forecast for the firm.
A CSFB analysis noted Novo's strong first half earnings, with a 10 percent increase in profit reported on Wednesday, but said that underlying figures were less favourable.

"An analysis of their results reveals modest volume growth, which is boosted by favourable currency trends. We are reducing our 1998 earnings forecast for Novo Nordisk and switching to a hold recommendation," it said.
It added that it was cutting its projected EBIT for Novo to 3.246 billion crowns from 3.405 billion. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom + (45) 33969650
